description: This Java source file defines an exception class 'AcknowledgementLabelNotDeclaredException', which is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.acks' package. The class extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and implements 'AcknowledgementException', representing a specific error scenario when an acknowledgement label isn't declared for a session or connection. It includes methods to create instances from label and JSON data, and a builder class for constructing exceptions with fluent API.
